explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 104 named tracks across Juno Recommends Techno: September 2026, Juno Recommends Electro: September 2026 and linked current/reissue catalogue pages. Written attributed descriptions and exact listings only; no audio audition.
exclusions: Jay Mitta — Sawa and Lotic — Carried remain removed after severe listener feedback; Luigi Tozzi — Tender Is The Night remains positively retained. Explicit threat- or panic-coded propositions were deprioritized without creating a blanket intensity or genre ban.

Completed discovery Runs 244–248 and persistent target/global discovery state were compared before ranking. Previously evaluated, parked, rejected, unresolved, duplicate and exact-alternate identities were excluded.
All ranked artist/title pairs were checked against canonical state, target-local discovery/rejection/PARKED history and the global utility ledger; none was found.
The top three leads come from distinct releases and test distinct non-frozen boundaries. No proposed placement touches either protected internal handoff in Transparency → When We Froze → Stardancer.
The previous run's zero-resolution outcome was not reused. This scan moved to different current, adjacent-electro and catalogue windows rather than retrying its identities.
sourceWindows: CURRENT RELEASE WINDOW: Juno Recommends Techno: September 2026, especially Steve Stoll and Ignez releases with differentiated exact-track descriptions. https://www.juno.co.uk/charts/juno-recommends/629051-Juno_Recommends_Techno/33361884-Chart

ADJACENT / EMERGING WINDOW: Juno Recommends Electro: September 2026, including Carl Finlow and Koloah material with machine-funk, slowing and vocal/electro movement relevant to the selection lens. https://www.juno.co.uk/charts/juno-recommends/629638-Juno_Recommends_Electro/33361863-Chart/

OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE / REISSUE WINDOW: Galaxy 2 Galaxy's 2026 reissue and Federsen/Estray's cross-rhythmic dub collaboration, inspected as recirculated and adjacent catalogue propositions rather than prestige picks. https://www.juno.co.uk/charts/juno-recommends/629051-Juno_Recommends_Techno/33361884-Chart
